ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, man is bound to lose himself

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ ەۙ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Illal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa tawāṣau bil-ḥaqq(i), wa tawāṣau biṣ-ṣabr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: unless he be of those who attain to faith, and do good works, and enjoin upon one another the keeping to truth, and enjoin upon one another patience in adversity.
